findings: Non-blocking: Caregiver mode routes to (caregiver)/dashboard, which is itself the clearly-marked PIN placeholder rather than a dedicated pin route. Matches the plan; Module 16 should give the PIN flow its own route rather than overloading dashboard.

Non-blocking: /health, /auth/*, and the people/memories/schedule/medications/assistant/games/trivia endpoints are typed against the documented ARCHITECTURE contract for backend modules that are still stubs, so those calls will 404 until later modules land. Expected and noted inline in each file.

Non-blocking: checkHealth sends no X-Role header on its pre-save probe. Fine today because /health is unauthenticated, but if /health later moves behind the role middleware the probe would 403 and read as unreachable. Worth a glance when HUB-3 /health lands.

Not a defect (expected): on-device boot (npx expo start on a physical Android device) is not and cannot be verified in a headless environment. MOB-1's device acceptance box is honestly left unchecked with a note; install (exit 0), tsc --noEmit (exit 0, zero errors), and expo-doctor (18/18) all pass per verification.md.
